title: Snippets in "{name}"
hint: Stored commands, to be sent via the snippet menu in the terminal. Placeholders: {host}, {user}, {port}, {name}. With a backend, everyone who sees the project sees them — passwords do not belong in them.
lockedHint: Locked snippets are changed only by owners and admins: only they can be a startup command, and a startup command runs unasked in every colleague's terminal. Open snippets are changed by whoever may edit the project.
targetHint: All connections of the project, or just one — then it moves along with it.
commandHint: Several lines are sent one after another, each with Enter.
lockHint: Only owners and admins can change or delete it. Only a locked snippet can be a connection's startup command.
locked: Locked — only owners and admins change it
staysLocked: Startup command of {names} — a startup command stays locked. Pick another one there first.
staysForThem: Startup command of {names} — it would no longer apply there. Pick another one there first.
deleteUsedBy: It is the startup command of {names} and is dropped there.
